name: OpenAI
description: An OpenAI account used as a model-provider connection for Meshery's AI Adapter, enabling natural-language-to-Design generation with a user-supplied API key.

registered.description: Validates the API key against OpenAI and makes it available for Design generation in Meshery.
Keeps the OpenAI registration but stops Meshery from using it for generation. You can connect it again whenever you choose.

connected.description: Disconnects OpenAI: it stops being available for Design generation. The registration is kept, so you can connect it again later.
Stops Meshery from using this provider for generation without deleting it. You can connect it again whenever you choose.
Removes the OpenAI connection and its credential from Meshery's database entirely.

disconnected.description: Re-validates the API key and makes OpenAI available for Design generation again.
Removes the OpenAI connection and its credential from Meshery's database entirely.

ignored.description: Resumes using this provider for Design generation.
Removes the OpenAI connection and its credential from Meshery's database entirely.

baseUrl.title: API Base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI API (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1). Override only for an OpenAI-compatible proxy or gateway you control.

organizationId.title: Organization ID
organizationId.description: Optional OpenAI organization identifier, used to scope usage and billing.

defaultModel.title: Default Model
defaultModel.description: Model used for Design generation unless overridden per request, e.g. gpt-4o.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: OpenAI secret key used to authenticate requests. Stored only in Meshery's Credential store.
